title: Wide flat strip: skin effect, AC resistance and internal inductance (magnetic fields AC, analytic)
description:
Planar magnetic_fields_ac, 1D in x: a copper strip 2b = 0.2 mm thick (solid conductor 'bar', drive current I0 = 1 A peak) between air gaps g = 0.1 mm and magnetic insulation faces (A = 0 on x_lo / x_hi: the return current flows in the image strips beyond them), symmetry on the y faces, so the window (h = 4 um high) is a slice of an infinitely wide strip and all impedances are per m of length for that slice. The surface fields are H = +-K / 2 (K = I0 / h) as on an isolated wide strip, so the current crowds onto both faces. Sweep f = 10 kHz .. 5 MHz (skin depth delta = 661 .. 29.6 um, u = b / delta = 0.15 .. 3.38); one host SuperLU solve per frequency.
Analytic (H = (K / 2) sinh(gamma x) / sinh(gamma b), gamma = (1 + j) / delta, written in real arithmetic): R_ac / R_dc = u (sinh 2u + sin 2u) / (cosh 2u - cos 2u) (1.000, 1.111 at 500 kHz, 2.06 at 2 MHz, 3.39 at 5 MHz; tends to u), internal inductance L_int / L_int,dc = 3 (sinh 2u - sin 2u) / (2u (cosh 2u - cos 2u)) (1 -> 0.444), with R_dc = 1 / (sigma 2b h), L_int,dc = mu0 b / (6h) and the gap inductance L_ext = mu0 g / (2h) (exact: uniform H in the gaps) taken off the coil inductance.
Derived values tab: R_ratio (coil resistance / R_dc), L_int_ratio ((coil inductance - L_ext) / L_int,dc), P_loss (eddy_loss = I0^2 R_ac / 2), W_mag (energy = I0^2 L / 4) and B_gap (mu0 K / 2 in the left gap). Expect ~1e-4 (second order in dx / delta, delta >= 30 cells; B_gap exact up to float32 storage); tolerances 2e-3 / 5e-3 (L_int is a difference).
Sweep tab: R_ratio and L_int_ratio vs f with the dashed formulas (log f axis), plus R_ratio_high_f = u, the thick-conductor asymptote R_dc b / delta (not checked).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 5 MHz): J_profile (J_total_abs, ~ cosh across the strip, 14.8 x higher at the faces than at the centre) and B_profile (B_abs: ~ sinh inside, mu0 K / 2 in the gaps).

parameters.name: I0
parameters.description: strip current amplitude (peak) in A, phase 0

parameters.name: b_half
parameters.description: strip half thickness b (thickness 2b along x)

parameters.name: g_gap
parameters.description: air gap between the strip faces and the insulation faces

parameters.name: h_y
parameters.description: window height (symmetry y faces: a slice of an infinitely wide strip)

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: skin depth sqrt(2 / (omega mu0 sigma)) in m

parameters.name: K_sheet
parameters.description: strip current per m of height K in A/m (surface fields +-K / 2)

parameters.name: R_dc
parameters.description: DC resistance per m of length of the slice in Ohm/m

parameters.name: L_ext
parameters.description: inductance of the two gaps per m of length in H/m (uniform H = K / 2)

parameters.name: L_int_dc
parameters.description: DC internal inductance per m of length in H/m

analytic_curves.name: J_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where(abs(x - x_mid) < b_half, K_sheet/2*sqrt(2)/delta*sqrt((cosh(2*(x - x_mid)/delta) + cos(2*(x - x_mid)/delta))/D_u), 0)

analytic_curves.name: B_profile
analytic_curves.expression: mu0_const*K_sheet/2*where(abs(x - x_mid) < b_half, sqrt((cosh(2*(x - x_mid)/delta) - cos(2*(x - x_mid)/delta))/D_u), 1)
